change_summary: Accepted measurement repair: live drift reconciliation now reads the hot OHLCV warehouse before stale warehouse surfaces and falls back on empty ticker coverage, removing current missing_entry_bar rows for live sleeve positions without changing orders, ranking, sizing, or exits.
hypothesis: Live drift reconciliation is undercounting current sleeve production drift because it reads stale warehouse surfaces while the daily hot OHLCV warehouse already contains entry/as-of bars for new live sleeve tickers.
next_retry_requires: Do not reserve another ID to refresh live-drift warehouse coverage for the same current-bar issue; the hot warehouse is now first in the lookup path.
Reopen only for a new live-vs-model drift mismatch, a concrete warehouse availability regression, or the documented exit-history v2 surface.
notes: Before: 7/11 positions reconciled and 4 sleeve positions were missing_entry_bar because stale warehouses ended before their entry dates or lacked TQQQ. After: 11/11 reconciled; sleeve weighted trajectory drift changed from -0.128387 to -0.039698. Alpha blocker fixed: real-money sleeve drift measurement now matches the daily hot warehouse surface used by current settlement.

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not rerun live drift reconciliation coverage as another measurement-repair ID just to pick up current OHLCV bars; the daily hot warehouse is now the first read surface and empty ticker coverage falls through to backups.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A valid retry needs a new production drift mismatch, a new warehouse availability regression, or the exit-side moomoo deal-history surface described in docs/live_drift_reconciliation.md.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The first live-drift implementation used the stale main/readcopy warehouses even though current daily settlement had already advanced warehouse_main_hot.sqlite. New sleeve tickers GEV, HOOD, SNXX, and TQQQ therefore looked unreconcilable despite valid entry/as-of bars in the hot warehouse.
